requirement: A skill that needs a topic whose home under {cite}`requirements.cli.skill_structure` is another skill MUST refer to that skill instead of restating the topic. It MAY summarize the topic in a few lines.
rationale:
The subject has two obligations. (1) A skill that needs a topic homed in another skill MUST refer to that skill. (2) It must not restate the topic. Summarizing in a few lines is a MAY, so it needs no test.

The test `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[bundled_skills_refer_to_a_topic_home_instead_of_restating_it]` covers both.

- **Referral.** For each of the five bundled skills, it calls `assert_phrases`. That helper asserts that the skill's `SKILL.md` and `references/` files, collapsed by `bundled_skill`, contain concrete referral phrases. Examples are "the habeas-evidence skill's `references/fixme.md`", "\"Choosing references\" in the habeas-requirements skill", "(habeas-refactor)" and "the habeas skill's `references/distributed-requirements.md`". Each skill has several referrals to the other skills that are the homes of topics it needs. A skill that dropped a referral would fail.
- **No restating.** For every skill, it loops over every other skill as a candidate home. It asserts that the skill's text contains none of that home's markers from `home_markers`. These are distinctive full-statement phrases, such as "A judgment is one of three outcomes", "## What the review checks" and "`--map requirements.cli.check=requirements.core.check`". This test checks all 5×4 skill pairs and covers every skill's markers. A skill that copied a home's content verbatim would fail.

A reviewer could say the markers are only a sample of each home's content, so a paraphrased restatement would pass. The requirement names no finer criterion for "restating". Fixed home phrases are a reasonable check for a text-content requirement, so I don't count this as a gap.

The parent `requirements.cli.skill_structure` is cited context. It has its own test, `bundled_skills_are_five_skill_directories_each_home_to_its_topics`. I did not reassess that test.

text: A skill that needs a topic whose home under {cite}`requirements.cli.skill_structure` is another skill MUST refer to that skill instead of restating the topic. It MAY summarize the topic in a few lines.

Habeas's bundled agent skills MUST jointly give the direction that the requirements on them specify. A skill consists of its `SKILL.md` and the files under its `references/` directory. Each topic MUST be stated in full in exactly one skill, its home.
